mapper.sql: state_id, scope_type, scope_key, pack_num, channel_name, model_num, state_code, state_value, state_level, source, source_ref_id, mode, opt_log_id, first_seen_time, last_change_time, last_update_time, expire_time, detail, remark
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO battery_device_state ( scope_type, scope_key, pack_num, channel_name, model_num, state_code, state_value, state_level, source, source_ref_id, mode, opt_log_id, first_seen_time, last_change_time, expire_time, detail, remark ) VALUES ( #{scopeType}, #{scopeKey}, #{packNum}, #{channelName}, #{modelNum}, #{stateCode}, #{stateValue}, #{stateLevel}, #{source}, #{sourceRefId}, #{mode}, #{optLogId}, #{firstSeenTime}, #{lastChangeTime}, #{expireTime}, #{detail}, #{remark} ) ON CONFLICT(scope_type, scope_key, state_code) DO UPDATE SET pack_num = excluded.pack_num, channel_name = excluded.channel_name, model_num = excluded.model_num, state_value = excluded.state_value, state_level = excluded.state_level, source = excluded.source, source_ref_id = excluded.source_ref_id, mode = excluded.mode, opt_log_id = excluded.opt_log_id, first_seen_time = COALESCE(battery_device_state.first_seen_time, excluded.first_seen_time), last_change_time = CASE WHEN excluded.state_value IS NOT NULL AND excluded.state_value != battery_device_state.state_value THEN excluded.last_change_time ELSE battery_device_state.last_change_time END, last_update_time = datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime'), expire_time = excluded.expire_time, detail = excluded.detail, remark = excluded.remark
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM battery_device_state WHERE scope_type = #{scopeType} AND scope_key = #{scopeKey}
DELETE FROM battery_device_state WHERE expire_time IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', expire_time) < strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime'))
